notes: CHELSA-native training, EFDA label, monotone XGB learner. Real held-out spatial-block CV (200km EPSG:3035 tiles, 80/20, 5 seeds, forward direction = deployable): AUC 0.568, F1@0.5 0.223, F1max 0.428 (recall@F1max 0.907). Monotone-constrained (non-decreasing risk with warming, by construction). Future period is a single climatological-normal snapshot (SSP5-8.5/MPI-ESM1-2-HR 2071-2100), not a multi-year forecast series.
